create_vocab_character: create a character-level vocabulary for tokenizing strings with no out-of-vocabulary characters
build_vocab_sentencepiece: build a SentencePiece vocabulary from a text corpus with configurable vocab size and model type
create_vocab_huggingface: create a HuggingFace tokenizer wrapper that converts text to token ids using a pretrained model
create_vocab_basic_english: create a basic English vocabulary with word-level tokenization and configurable word list
create_vocab_decoder: create a decoder vocabulary that converts objects to token ids and back with multi-objective support
